decided_by: Product owner (packet P-LEG review: 'we don't pick the investment funds and pass all of fund management off to someone like Schwab')
decision: Neither Unbound nor the sponsor selects or manages investments and no sponsor-maintained investment pools are offered. Each sponsor delegates investment management of fund assets to an external registered investment manager or custodian platform (for example Schwab) under a written agreement. The sponsor board keeps the non-delegable duties to select the manager, set the scope and investment policy, and monitor performance and cost. Donors may recommend allocations only among options the manager makes available; Unbound relays those recommendations and ingests positions, transactions, units and valuations, and reconciles them.
